scope: k = 1 (and a k = 2 confirmation on the fine grid) post height sweep at fixed mesh, carried to Im = 0 or to the two-cell tip clearance limit, 5 frequencies inside +-2 mode linewidths, full six-wall frequency solve
limitation: post is a bundle of k^2 thin wires with E_axial forced to zero; the lateral post surface is not enforced; port is a wall delta gap at 1 A, not a coaxial/SMA opening with an outer conductor and reference plane; tip is kept two cells below the top wall, so the post is never shorted to it, and no height beyond nz - 2 cells is claimed
